# cloudflare-next-intl-auth

> Firebase Auth & App Check integration for Next.js App Router and Cloudflare Workers.

## Key Subpaths

- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth`: core auth functions
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/firebaseAuthClient`: client initialization
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/firebaseAuthClientProvider`: React client provider
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/firebaseAuthServerProvider`: RSC server provider
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/useFirebaseAuthUser`: user hook
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/getFirebaseAuthUser`: server user getter
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/resolveOptionalAuthUser`: optional auth getter
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/firebaseAuthActions`: actions helper
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/firebaseAuthMiddleware`: updateSession middleware handler
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/checkFirebaseAuthConfig`: static build checker
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/types`: auth types
- `cloudflare-next-intl-auth/normalizeConfig`: leading-slash path normalization
